cohort: A total of 121 pregnancies in 80 SLE patients with a mean age of 27.1 years and a mean disease duration of 4.6 years were reviewed from five multi-specialist referral centres across Karnataka, India.
finding: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) were strongly associated with stillbirth and prematurity, independent of active lupus, while conception during stable disease was associated with a low risk of major flare, and hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) use reduced the risk of flare in patients in remission.
